# AS07 provenance

as07_reference.py is the byte-identical AS07_Shelter_Generator.py provided for this project. Its SPDX MIT header, comments and original code are preserved. The source is an original fictional environment asset, not structural/real construction design.

The new adapter is in ../core.py. It does not execute the original create_blender_scene(), main(), render or export functions. Source identity is recorded in the development reports/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json.
